name: Pacific herring
description: Pacific herring (Clupea pallasii), a single species tracked by the source. The key forage fish of PWS: it converts zooplankton (euphausiids, copepods, mysids, amphipods) into food for fish, birds and mammals, and supported major seine, gillnet and spawn-on-kelp fisheries in the 1980s. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
